governing_question: Does a training-only Bayesian expert mixture improve December 2024 prediction of participation, physical mass and statistical unit value for Spanish chapter-72 trade cells?

jurisdiction.material_scope: all chapter 72 iron and steel records
exclusions: biological materials as the only industrial test

causal_order: download and aggregate January-November one archive at a time in memory
fit all expert weights using rolling-origin folds contained within January-November
write and hash the complete December prediction freeze
only then open and aggregate the December archive
score the frozen predictions without refitting

targets.participation: presence of a training-universe cell in December
targets.quantity: aggregate net mass in kg, conditional on target presence and positive mass
targets.statistical_unit_value: aggregate statistical value in EUR divided by aggregate net mass in kg, conditional on positive numerator and denominator
targets.supplementary_units: retained but not modeled because the unit is commodity-specific
targets.invoice_value: retained for audit but not called a market price

models.bma_weights: equal-prior posterior expert weights learned from monthly rolling-origin likelihoods; each month contributes one mean log-likelihood unit to limit false cross-sectional independence

scores.uncertainty: 2000-replicate deterministic CN4 cluster bootstrap of paired mean-loss differences

storage_contract.processing: one archive at a time in RAM on GitHub Actions
storage_contract.durable_outputs: compressed normalized aggregates, prediction freeze, score ledgers, manifest and result summary

claim_boundary.industrial_domain_extension: eligible only as retrospective evidence after execution
claim_boundary.BIND_readiness: may reduce the industrial-demo blocker; cannot establish customer, transaction-price or commercial validation
